literal_meaning: নিজের কথা বা গল্পই পাঁচভাবে বলা (one's own words or stories told in five ways)
figurative_meaning_en: A person entirely devoted to self-promotion or boasting about oneself
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় নিজের কথাই পাঁচকাহন করে, অন্যের কথা শোনে না।
পার্টিতে গিয়ে সে আবার নিজের কথাই পাঁচকাহন শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He always talks only about himself in five different ways and doesn't listen to others.
At the party, he started boasting about himself again in exaggerated tales.
note: The idiom implies excessive and repetitive self-centered storytelling, common in Bengali oral traditions.
